description:
"It's my first time. So please, teach me, okay?"

"I've told you time and again that I think of you as family." 

"I don't know anything about that. I just... I want to do it with you, Executive Director." 

As she waited for Sangheon's reply, Dajeong swallowed hard. Sangheon's gaze fell upon Dajeong's glistening, red lips. 

"You want to do it too, don't you? I know it's not just me."

Looking down at the blushing Dajeong, Sangheon thought to himself: If a child wants to play with fire, you have to let them touch the flame for them to come to their senses. He would teach her the truth that the world is not as easy as she thinks. 

"You're the one who started this." 

It was a truly arrogant and foolish judgment.
